$comment: Update manifest — host at repo root on the main branch. Fetched via raw.githubusercontent.com. Update this file as part of every release; the app falls back to the GitHub Releases API if this file is unreachable.

notes.en:
Improved PDF user and owner password handling and clarified document restrictions versus current-session permissions. Unified password, permission, and encryption settings into one Document security settings dialog with explicit Keep, Change, and Remove actions and a clearer layout.

Added certificate-based PDF protection with recipient public certificate import, digital identity import through the operating system, and support for opening certificate-protected PDFs using an accessible private key. Saving encrypted copies now runs in the background with stage-based progress and cancellation; EJoyPDF does not retain private keys.
